quick_skim.title: GUIDE: Guiding Internal Evidence with Language Instructions
quick_skim.abstract: Large multimodal models follow instructions about what to generate, but not necessarily about what evidence to rely on. Hence, models may continue to depend on shortcut-associated cues even when instructions suggest otherwise. We introduce GUIDE, a framework for controlling internal evidence usage through language instructions. GUIDE combines grouped parameter-efficient adaptation with instruction-conditioned gating to modulate multimodal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation. We further introduce a pathway-level evaluation framework that characterizes instruction-conditioned evidence modulation through reliance sensitivity, controlled perturbation analysis, pathway modulation, and autoregressive decoding dynamics. Across multimodal reasoning, classification, and generation, GUIDE induces structured and instruction-aligned redistribution of evidence reliance while largely preserving task behavior. Experiments on GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and Flickr30K show that GUIDE improves robustness under targeted evidence perturbations and enables controllable modulation across diverse multimodal settings. This suggests that multimodal instruction following can extend beyond output control toward regulating how different evidence sources contribute to model predictions.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Language-instruction-controlled gating and pathway-level evaluation reveal internal evidence usage in large multimodal models

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Large multimodal models follow content instructions but not evidence-use instructions. GUIDE uses grouped parameter-efficient adaptation plus instruction-conditioned gating to control internal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation, and provides a pathway-level evaluation for reliance sensitivity and controlled perturbations.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 多模态大模型会服从生成内容指令，却不一定会按指令调整所依赖的内部证据，因此常继续使用捷径关联线索。本文提出GUIDE框架，结合分组参数高效适配与指令条件门控，在推理和生成中按语言指令调节多模态证据通路。文章还给出通路级评估框架，利用依赖敏感性、可控扰动、通路调制与解码动态刻画证据使用。该方法为大型多模态模型提供了证据可控的可解释推理机制。

quick_skim.title: Interpretability for Turing Machines
quick_skim.abstract: We show that susceptibilities, an interpretability technique developed for neural networks, can identify the presence of algorithmic structure in Turing machines by probing the local loss landscape of a learning problem for noisy Turing machines introduced by Murfet and Troiani (arXiv:2504.08075). We prove that symmetries and path separation in the algorithm implemented by a Turing machine induce permutation symmetries and low-rank blocks in its susceptibility matrix. We study this empirically on a set of deterministic finite automata (DFAs) and demonstrate that algorithmic features can be recovered by principal component analysis and clustering methods in susceptibility space.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: applies neural interpretability susceptibilities to symbolic Turing machines and DFAs

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The paper applies susceptibility-based interpretability to Turing machines and DFAs, proving that algorithmic symmetries and path separation create detectable low-rank structure in susceptibility matrices.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 将神经网络可解释性中的敏感性(susceptibilities)技术引入符号系统，论文分析了噪声图灵机学习问题中的局部损失景观，并证明算法中的对称性和路径分离会导致敏感性矩阵出现置换对称性与低秩块。在确定性有限自动机实验中，PCA和聚类能从敏感性空间恢复算法特征。这表明原本面向神经网络的解释工具也能用于揭示图灵机等符号算法的内部结构，是神经可解释性与符号模型之间的一种联通。
